decisions.question: Should the board's built-in Item closed workflow be turned off, so a reopened idea comes back with the Status it had instead of Done?
decisions.recommended: Yes: turn off Item closed in the board's Workflows settings before the merge, since the sync already sets Done and closes the issue for every card it owns.
decisions.alternative: Leave it on, and move a reopened idea out of the Done column by hand.
decisions.answer: Yes: the owner turns off Item closed in the board's Workflows settings before the merge; the sync sets Done and closes the issue for every card it owns.

decisions.question: Should 008 also show a card as Building while it is built locally, through a building label that /speckit-card-implement puts on the card issue at pickup?
decisions.recommended: Yes: card implement adds a building label to the card issue with gh issue edit at pickup; the sync shows an open card issue with that label as at least Building while the derived stage is Specified, and removes the label once a pushed branch or PR carries the stage; the owner can also set the label by hand.
decisions.alternative: Ship 008 as is and make the label its own feature later.
decisions.answer: Yes: fold Building at pickup into 008 (label added by card implement at pickup, sync shows at least Building while derived stage is Specified, label removed once a branch or PR carries the stage, owner may set it by hand). Rejected: setting Status with gh project item-edit (sync reverts it) and pushing early (breaks the recompose rule).

decisions.question: Should a building label on a card issue count whoever added it, or only when the board owner added it?
decisions.recommended: Count it whoever added it: only accounts with triage or write access can label issues in this repository, which today means the owner and twinright-bzs, and checking who added it costs one more read per labeled issue on every run.
decisions.alternative: Count it only when the board owner added it, so a label another collaborator adds leaves the card at Specified.
decisions.answer: Whoever added it: any building label on an open card issue at Specified shows Building; no timeline read.

decisions.question: Should /speckit-bug-fix also add the building label at pickup, or is bug fix out of scope?
decisions.recommended: Out of scope: only card implement adds the label; a label added by hand to a bug issue still works.
decisions.alternative: Wrap bug fix too, with one more preset wrap, test and reapply.
decisions.answer: Wrap bug fix too: /speckit-bug-fix adds the building label to the bug's card issue at pickup, through a kcc-ship preset wrap, test-first, regenerated by reapply.sh.
